attr.title: The ReThing
attr.desc: Experimental ARM64 port of The Thing (2002). This build targets H700 with proprietary Mali GLES. User-owned game files required; stable 30 FPS is not achieved.
attr.inst: Extract into ports. For an older install, rename ports/the-thing to ports/the_rething before extracting; preserve bin, data, config and userdata. Launch The ReThing to verify existing files, or put the supported ISO in the_rething/source/the_thing.iso. No Python required. Requires Bash, glibc 2.36+, SDL2, SDL2_ttf and libmali.so.0. See README.md for the supported ISO checksum.
